name: Direct work with one executor

work.goal: Recommend a short title for a supplied project note.
success_criteria: The proposed title preserves the note's stated purpose.
non_goals: No team recruitment, source lookup or saved project change.

conditions: Self-checking is sufficient for this illustrative low-impact task.

roles.responsibility: Read the note, propose a title, check its meaning and use the result.

inputs.content: Keep the original evidence and unfinished questions when work resumes.
inputs.limitations: Supplied fixture text, with no external source verification.

steps.purpose: Propose and self-check one concise title.
steps.returns: A proposed title and why it fits the supplied note.

arrangements.description: One executor performs the compatible contribution, check and use roles.
assumptions: No independent verification is claimed or required.

reconsider_when: The note's purpose changes or the proposed title omits its meaning.
